summary: Tencent Music Entertainment Group filed a Form 6-K on September 3, 2026, announcing the pricing of a $1.0 billion senior notes offering of unsecured notes, split between $500 million of 5.050% notes due 2031 and $500 million of 5.650% notes due 2036. This is an ordinary debt financing transaction on an automatic shelf registration statement, with net proceeds of roughly $991.9 million for general corporate purposes, including refinancing offshore debt and share repurchases. Joint bookrunners include J.P. Morgan, Goldman Sachs (Asia), and HSBC. The notes will be listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange. This is a routine debt offering, not a special situation; proceeds may support future capital returns but no share repurchase plan is specified.
